name: Maker.js
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Parametric 2D line models in Node with union and outline offset, exported to SVG and DXF
summary: Maker.js (npm makerjs) builds 2D models from lines, arcs and Béziers, combines them (union, intersection) and offsets outlines in Node with no browser, then exports SVG, DXF, PDF or OpenJSCAD. Its strength is real geometry operations on headless, precision-controlled vector line work for laser, plotter and technical-drawing stills.
use_when: Parametric technical line art with an offset or outline operation, as SVG or DXF, in Node
Union or intersection of shapes into one clean path; over paper-js when no browser model is wanted
Laser or plotter-ready stills; vpype then optimises the SVG
avoid_when: Interactive or animated vector scenes: paper-js, konva or anime-js
Optimising an existing plotter SVG: vpype
notes: 2026-11-27: the last npm release (0.19.2, 2026-01-27) is ten months old although commits continue; text needs a font loaded through opentype.js, untested here.

assessment.rationale: npm makerjs 0.19.2, Apache-2.0, repository pushed 2026-10-29. Headless outline offset and union with DXF out is absent from paper-js (browser model), vpype (post-process) and build123d (3D); release cadence is slow.

evidence.result: Union of rounded rectangle and circle, 3 mm outline offset: plate 80x50 mm, outline 86x56 mm, 21 DXF entities; SVG and DXF identical across two Node 22.19.0 processes; resvg 0.47.0 PNGs 800x501 and 800x522 inspected.
evidence.scope: Union and outline offset of one plate to SVG and DXF, macOS arm64; stroke clips at viewBox edge; not text, Béziers, chains, layout, PDF or OpenJSCAD.
